description: Reviewed direct host-clock boundaries. Workflow-facing date/time decisions must use lifetxt.timezone_policy; only operational, compatibility, animation, and timezone-foundation calls are allowed here.

allowed.reason: Lock token uniqueness and stale-lock age use wall-clock seconds; they do not select life.txt workflow dates.
allowed.removal_condition: Replace with an injected operational clock only if lock testing needs cross-process deterministic time.

allowed.reason: Lock metadata records UTC creation evidence and is not a user-facing workflow timestamp.
allowed.removal_condition: Move to a shared operational UTC clock when audit event infrastructure is introduced.

allowed.reason: Revision migration observation windows and evidence timestamps are UTC operational telemetry.
allowed.removal_condition: Inject the operational UTC clock when telemetry persistence gains a pluggable backend.

allowed.reason: Lock-age inspection and host timezone discovery report environment state rather than choosing workflow dates.
allowed.removal_condition: Split lock inspection and host-zone discovery into injectable platform adapters.

allowed.reason: Timestamps the pre-update backup directory name for the guarded production update flow; it is recovery evidence naming, not a life.txt workflow date choice.
allowed.removal_condition: Route through a shared operational UTC clock when a common operational-clock helper is introduced, matching transaction_journal.py.

allowed.reason: Legacy revision fallback telemetry records a UTC last-used time during the compatibility window.
allowed.removal_condition: Delete with the observe-mode compatibility fallback.

allowed.reason: Legacy time-only parsing anchors values for callers that have not supplied the shared timezone date context.
allowed.removal_condition: Remove after every public caller supplies an explicit anchor date through timezone_policy.

allowed.reason: relative_time()'s fallback default when a caller supplies no explicit today; every current lifetxt caller (cli.py, extra_core.py, tui.py) already passes an explicit workspace-aware today from lifetxt.timezone_policy, so this path is reached only by a caller outside that convention.
allowed.removal_condition: Remove after every public caller of relative_time() supplies an explicit anchor date through timezone_policy.

allowed.reason: This is the authoritative injectable boundary used by all workflow-facing clock helpers and host-zone fallback.
allowed.removal_condition: None; this is the approved clock foundation.

allowed.reason: Journal creation, terminal retention, and evidence timestamps are UTC recovery metadata, with explicit now injection supported by policy actions.
allowed.removal_condition: Route through a shared operational UTC clock when journal backends become pluggable.

allowed.reason: The timestamp drives transient TUI animation/toast expiry and never affects persisted records.
allowed.removal_condition: Use time.monotonic when the TUI renderer is split from workspace state.

allowed.reason: Paces the Remote TUI backend's bounded background poll interval (#680); it schedules a network request cadence and never selects or persists a life.txt workflow date.
allowed.removal_condition: Use time.monotonic if the poll scheduler is ever isolated from wall-clock display concerns.
